info.title: Friendship Points API
info.description: The optional `x-user-id` header selects a development user for owner-scoped routes. It is not authentication. When omitted the API uses a seeded development user. The embedding maintenance route has no user check.

get.description: Returns active friends belonging to the selected development user.

parameters.name: x-user-id
parameters.description: Development user ID selector. This is not authentication. If omitted the seeded development user is used.

500.description: A provider, database or unexpected server error occurred.
